ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SELECTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_selection IS
rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'PF_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'test_id',CHAR_COLUMN,10); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'test_desc',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 

 go_block('valid_tests');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :valid_tests.chk_box = 'Y' then
 :ctrl_block2.lv_select := 'TRUE';
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.test_id',curr_group_row,:valid_tests.test_id);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.test_desc',curr_group_row,:valid_tests.test_desc);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */
 hide_window('window2');
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 go_block('dvt_block');
 last_record;
 ref_record_number := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 if :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 flag := 0;
 end if;
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 :dvt_block.test_id := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.test_id',i); 
 :dvt_block.test_desc := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.test_desc',i); 
 create_record;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 go_record(ref_record_number); 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_UNIT_TEST_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_unit_test_results IS
rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'TEST_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
 loc_test_id varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'test_id',CHAR_COLUMN,10); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'test_desc',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 

 go_block('dvt_block');
 first_record;
 loop
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.test_id',curr_group_row,:dvt_block.test_id);
 set_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.test_desc',curr_group_row,:dvt_block.test_desc);
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */

 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 loc_test_id := get_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.test_id',i); 
 go_block('unit_test_results');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :unit_test_results.UNIT_ID is not null then
 insert into UNIT_TEST_RESULTS 
 (unit_id,test_id,chapter_id,program_id,insert_date,insert_user )
 values
 (:unit_test_results.unit_id,loc_test_id,
 :global.chapter_id,:banner.prog_name,sysdate,:banner.user_id); 
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 COMMIT;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
if :global.unit_id != :unit_test_results.unit_id then /* new check */
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C15',:global.unit_id||
 ',','D',chk); 
end if;
 
if :global.unit_id = :unit_test_results.unit_id then
 null;
else
 if :unit_test_results.unit_id is not null then
 /* no data base check */
 if :system.record_status IN ('INSERT','CHANGED') then
 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C15',:unit_test_results.unit_id||
 ',','U',chk); 
 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;
end if; /* 1st if then */
END;
